title: Mechanical Oracle Sphere
description: A large metallic spherical device with intricate steampunk machinery and multiple cables extending outward. Inside the glass dome, a vibrant surreal face is split between a bright green profile with a spiral eye and a flowing abstract form in magenta, cyan, and purple.
prompt: A large ornate metallic sphere with brass fittings and multiple thick cables and tubes extending from it like a mechanical oracle. Inside the glass dome is a surreal split portrait of a face: one side is a vibrant lime green profile with a spiral eye, the other side dissolves into flowing abstract shapes of magenta, cyan and deep purple against a smoky dark background with floating particles.
